name: price-elsewhere
description: Chrome extension comparing a product's price across Ozon, Wildberries and Yandex Market. No runtime dependencies; the tests need none either.

scripts.test: node tests/run.cjs && node tests/background.cjs && node tests/content.cjs && node tests/privacy-copy.cjs && node tests/panel-pricing.cjs
scripts.check: for f in src/*.js popup/*.js tests/*.cjs; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && npm test
